URL https://cryptostruct.com/download/cryptostruct-dl.py
STATUS 200 text/plain; charset=utf-8

#!/usr/bin/env python3 # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ cryptostruct-dl — the official download tool for CryptoStruct market-data orders. Single file, Python >= 3.9, standard library only. python3 cryptostruct_dl.py --order ORDER_ID --token T [options] python3 cryptostruct_dl.py --key cs_dl_... [options] python3 cryptostruct_dl.py --manifest FILE_OR_URL [--token T] [--key K] [options] Sections (in file order): Helpers · Http · Manifest · Ledger · Planner · Poller · Bundles · Downloader · Verify · Report · CLI Exit codes: 0 everything complete · 1 incomplete (failed / cold / left pending / throttled) · 2 usage error, manifest 404, expired link (410) · 3 interrupted (Ctrl-C) · 4 another run is using the same --out directory. Large orders (1.1): a manifest with a `page` block (or an account manifest with `large_orders`) is walked page by page — bounded memory, a SQLite ledger, files that are not ready within --page-wait-min are left for the next run. Direct downloads (1.2): every request carries `X-CryptoStruct-Direct: 1`, so a single file may answer 302 to a short-lived storage URL and the bytes come straight from storage. `--key` travels as an unredirected header — it never leaves the CryptoStruct host (storage rejects a second credential anyway). Partial delivery per day (1.4): a range chunk whose day makes no progress for --stuck-day-min (or that turns out cold without --restore) is split — every day already complete in the partial tar is unpacked into / / /, the rest comes one day at a time, the stuck day last. Rate limits (1.5): a 429 from CryptoStruct pauses EVERY worker for its Retry-After (one shared gate in front of every request to the shop) and never counts against --max-wait-min / --page-wait-min — those budgets are for files that are not ready. A file the server keeps refusing for 30 min is reported as "throttled". Before the run ends, the files it left behind are asked for once more (large orders: pending and throttled, via a fresh new-only manifest; small orders: throttled). One run per --out directory: a second one (a cron overlap) exits 4 at once. """ import argparse import base64 import concurrent.futures import datetime as _dt import email.utils import hashlib import http.client import json import os import random import re import shutil import socket import subprocess import sys import tarfile import threading import time import urllib.error import urllib.parse import urllib.request import zipfile try: # POSIX run lock (one run per --out directory); Windows uses msvcrt below import fcntl except ImportError: # pragma: no cover fcntl = None try: import msvcrt except ImportError: msvcrt = None try: # stdlib, but missing from some minimal Python builds — only large orders need it import sqlite3 except ImportError: # pragma: no cover sqlite3 = None __version__ = "1.5.0" USER_AGENT = "cryptostruct-dl/" + __version__ # Opt-in for single-file 302s to storage (see Http): we follow them, never with the Bearer. DIRECT_HEADER = "X-CryptoStruct-Direct" DEFAULT_BASE = "https://cryptostruct.com" SCHEMA_ID = "cryptostruct.download-manifest/1" LEDGER_SCHEMA = "cryptostruct-dl.ledger/1" LEDGER_DIR = ".cryptostruct-dl" LEDGER_FILE = "ledger.json" LEDGER_SQLITE = "ledger.sqlite" # large orders (paged manifests) — one row per file SIDECAR_NAME = "cryptostruct-dl.sha256" PART_SUFFIX = ".part" META_SUFFIX = ".part.json" FORMAT_TOKENS = ("trades.csv.gz", "bbo.csv.gz", "liquidations.csv.gz", "trades.parquet", "liquidations.parquet") CHUNK_SIZE = 1024 * 1024 # bytes per read while streaming JSON_BODY_LIMIT = 8 * 1024 * 1024 # never read more than this for a JSON/NDJSON body HTTP_TIMEOUT_S = 60.0 # socket connect/read timeout MAX_TRANSIENT_TRIES = 8 # 5xx / network errors per item BACKOFF_BASE_S = 5.0 BACKOFF_CAP_S = 120.0 DEFAULT_RETRY_AFTER_S = 30.0 # when a pending answer carries no Retry-After MIN_POLL_S = 1.0 MAX_POLL_S = 900.0 ZIP_PARALLEL = 2 # bundle days in flight at once (zips, or direct member lists) DIRECT_PARALLEL = 8 # member files of one direct bundle day in flight at once DIRECT_REFRESH_MAX = 3 # fresh URL lists per member before giving up (storage URLs expire) SHUTDOWN_GRACE_S = 10.0 DEFAULT_PAGE_WAIT_MIN = 2.0 # paged mode: per-file wait before it is left for the next run DEFAULT_RESTORE_MAX = 500 # paged mode: --restore requests per run DEFAULT_STUCK_DAY_MIN = 15.0 # range chunk: minutes without progress on one day before it is split into days SALVAGE_DISK_MARGIN = 256 * 1024 * 1024 # free bytes kept on top of the partial tar when unpacking it SALVAGE_DIR_PREFIX = ".salvage-" # staging dir of a day unpacked from a partial range tar REPORT_MAX_ROWS = 1000 # paged mode: problem rows kept for the report THROTTLE_MAX_PER_ITEM_S = 1800.0 # 429 waits on ONE file before it is reported as throttled (1.5) RETRY_MAX_KEYS = 200000 # paged mode: files remembered for the second pass (bounded memory) LOCK_FILE = "run.lock" # /.cryptostruct-dl/run.lock — one run per output directory EXIT_LOCKED = 4 # Tests scale every sleep down to zero; production keeps 1.0. SLEEP_SCALE = float(os.environ.get("CRYPTOSTRUCT_DL_SLEEP_SCALE", "1") or 1) ZSTD_BIN = shutil.which("zstd") DATE_RE = re.compile(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$") DATE_IN_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})") MANIFEST_LINE_RE = re.compile(r"^(\d+)\t(.+)$") # " \t " lines of a day's MANIFEST.txt # ───────────────────────────── Helpers ───────────────────────────── class DlError(Exception): """Base class for everything the tool raises on purpose.""" class UsageError(DlError): """Wrong invocation, bad manifest, manifest 404/403 → exit 2.""" class ManifestUnreachable(DlError): """Manifest could not be fetched (network/5xx after retries) → exit 1.""" class ExpiredLink(DlError): """HTTP 410 anywhere → stop everything → exit 2.""" class ItemFailed(DlError): """Permanent per-item failure (404/403/verify/…) → item failed, run continues.""" class ItemCold(DlError): """Item sits in cold storage and --restore was not given.""" class ItemPending(DlError): """Waited longer than --max-wait-min on one item.""" class ItemThrottled(DlError): """The server kept answering 429 on one item for THROTTLE_MAX_PER_ITEM_S.""" class Interrupted(DlError): """Ctrl-C (or a fatal error elsewhere) asked this worker to stop.""" class TransientError(DlError): """Network error / 5xx — retried with backoff by the caller.""" class VerifyError(DlError): """A completed file did not pass verification.""" class SplitChunk(DlError): """413 RANGE_TOO_LARGE: split the chunk at `suggested_to`.""" def __init__(self, suggested_to): DlError.__init__(self, "range too large, split at %s" % suggested_to) self.suggested_to = suggested_to class RangeNotFound(DlError): """404 on the range route → fall back to per-day zips.""" class StuckRange(DlError): """A range chunk waits on one day that made no progress for --stuck-day-min → split into days.""" def __init__(self, date, waited_s): DlError.__init__(self, "no progress on %s for %s" % (date or "the range", human_duration(waited_s))) self.date = date self.waited_s = waited_s class UseTar(DlError): """413 TOO_LARGE on a day zip → use the day's tar_url.""" def utc_now(): return _dt.datetime.now(_dt.timezone.utc) def utc_now_iso(): return utc_now().strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") def human_bytes(n): if n is None: return "?" try: f = float(n) except (TypeError, ValueError): return "?" units = ("B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB", "PB") i = 0 while f >= 1000.0 and i :` → lowercase hex, or None.""" if not value: return None m = re.search(r"sha-256=:([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+):", str(value)) if not m: return None try: raw = base64.b64decode(m.group(1), validate=True) except (ValueError, TypeError): return None if len(raw) != 32: return None return raw.hex() def parse_content_range(value): """`bytes START-END/TOTAL` or `bytes */TOTAL` → (start, end, total); None where unknown.""" if not value: return None m = re.match(r"\s*bytes\s+(\*|\d+-\d+)/(\*|\d+)\s*$", str(value)) if not m: return None start = end = total = None if m.group(1) != "*": a, b = m.group(1).split("-") start, end = int(a), int(b) if m.group(2) != "*": total = int(m.group(2)) return (start, end, total) def parse_content_disposition_filename(value): if not value: return None v = str(value) m = re.search(r"filename\*\s*=\s*(?:UTF-8|utf-8)''([^;]+)", v) if m: name = urllib.parse.unquote(m.group(1).strip()) else: m = re.search(r'filename\s*=\s*"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"', v) if m: name = m.group(1).replace('\\"', '"') else: m = re.search(r"filename\s*=\s*([^;]+)", v) if not m: return None name = m.group(1).strip() name = safe_component(name) return name if name != "_" else None def parse_ndjson_summary(text): """Last `{summary: …}` line of an NDJSON body, or None.""" lines = [ln for ln in str(text).splitlines() if ln.strip()] for ln in reversed(lines): try: obj = json.loads(ln) except ValueError: continue if isinstance(obj, dict) and isinstance(obj.get("summary"), dict): return obj["summary"] return None def first_unready_date(text): """First day line of a range status (NDJSON) that is not ready: pending/cold members or state=error.""" for ln in str(text).splitlines(): try: obj = json.loads(ln) except ValueError: continue if not isinstance(obj, dict) or not obj.get("date"): continue counts = obj.get("counts") if isinstance(obj.get("counts"), dict) else {} if obj.get("state") == "error" or as_int(counts.get("pending")) > 0 or as_int(counts.get("cold")) > 0: return str(obj["date"]) return None def backoff_seconds(attempt): """Exponential 5 s → 120 s with ±25 % jitter; attempt starts at 1.""" base = min(BACKOFF_CAP_S, BACKOFF_BASE_S * (2 ** max(0, attempt - 1))) return base * random.uniform(0.75, 1.25) def as_int(value, default=0): try: return int(value) except (TypeError, ValueError): return default def sha256_file(path): h = hashlib.sha256() with open(path, "rb") as fh: while True: chunk = fh.read(CHUNK_SIZE) if not chunk: break h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest() def read_json_file(path): with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh: return json.load(fh) def write_json_atomic(path, obj): d = os.path.dirname(path) if d: os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True) tmp = "%s.tmp.%d" % (path, os.getpid()) with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh: json.dump(obj, fh, indent=1, sort_keys=True) fh.write("\n") os.replace(tmp, path) def read_part_meta(part_path): meta_path = part_path[: -len(PART_SUFFIX)] + META_SUFFIX if part_path.endswith(PART_SUFFIX) else part_path + ".json" try: obj = read_json_file(meta_path) return obj if isinstance(obj, dict) else {} except (OSError, ValueError): return {} def write_part_meta(part_path, meta): meta_path = part_path[: -len(PART_SUFFIX)] + META_SUFFIX if part_path.endswith(PART_SUFFIX) else part_path + ".json" try: write_json_atomic(meta_path, meta) except OSError: pass def remove_quiet(path): try: os.remove(path) except OSError: pass def meta_path_for(part_path): return part_path[: -len(PART_SUFFIX)] + META_SUFFIX class Masker: """Never let a token or key reach a log line.""" def __init__(self): self._secrets = [] def add(self, secret): if not secret: return s = str(secret) if len(s) 0 else 0.0 added = max(0.0, seconds - left) self.pauses += 1 if started else 0 self.paused_s += added self._current_s += added self.longest_s = max(self.longest_s, self._current_s) self._until = max(self._until, until) return started def wait(self): """Block until the gate is open (Ctrl-C wakes it).""" while True: with self._lock: left = self._until - time.monotonic() if left /.cryptostruct-dl/run.lock: it disappears with the process, never stale.""" def __init__(self, out_dir): self.dir = os.path.join(out_dir, LEDGER_DIR) self.path = os.path.join(self.dir, LOCK_FILE) self.fh = None def acquire(self): """True when this process now holds the lock (or the platform has no locking at all).""" os.makedirs(self.dir, exist_ok=True) fh = open(self.path, "a+", encoding="utf-8") try: if fcntl is not None: fcntl.flock(fh.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB) elif msvcrt is not None: # pragma: no cover — Windows fh.seek(0) msvcrt.locking(fh.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_NBLCK, 1) except OSError: fh.close() return False if fcntl is not None: try: fh.seek(0) fh.truncate() fh.write("pid %d since %s\n" % (os.getpid(), utc_now_iso())) fh.flush() except OSError: pass self.fh = fh return True def holder(self): """'pid N since …' of the run holding the lock, when the platform lets us read it.""" try: with open(self.path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh: return fh.read(200).strip() or None except OSError: return None def release(self): fh, self.fh = self.fh, None if fh is None: return try: if fcntl is not None: fcntl.flock(fh.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN) elif msvcrt is not None: # pragma: no cover — Windows fh.seek(0) msvcrt.locking(fh.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_UNLCK, 1) except OSError: pass try: fh.close() except OSError: pass # ───────────────────────────── Http ───────────────────────────── class HttpResponse: def __init__(self, status, headers, fp, url): self.status = int(status) self.headers = headers self._fp = fp self.url = url self._body = None def header(self, name, default=None): if self.headers is None: return default v = self.headers.get(name) return default if v is None else v def content_length(self): v = self.header("Content-Length") if v is None: return None try: return int(v) except ValueError: return None def retry_after(self): return parse_retry_after(self.header("Retry-After")) def read(self, limit=JSON_BODY_LIMIT): if self._body is None: try: self._body = self._fp.read(limit) if self._fp is not None else b"" except (OSError, http.client.HTTPException): self._body = b"" return self._body def text(self): return self.read().decode("utf-8", "replace") def json(self): try: return json.loads(self.text()) except ValueError: return None def error_code(self): j = self.json() if isinstance(j, dict): err = j.get("error") if isinstance(err, dict): return err.get("code") if isinstance(err, str): return err return j.get("code") return None def error_obj(self): j = self.json() if isinstance(j, dict): err = j.get("error") if isinstance(err, dict): return err return j return {} def iter_chunks(self, size=CHUNK_SIZE): while True: chunk = self._fp.read(size) if not chunk: break yield chunk def close(self): try: if self._fp is not None: self._fp.close() except (OSError, ValueError): pass class Http: """urllib opener with the tool's User-Agent on every request, optional Bearer. The Bearer is an UNREDIRECTED header: urllib copies ordinary headers onto a redirected request, and a single file may 302 to a presigned storage URL — the key must never reach that host (it answers 400 to a second credential). `X-CryptoStruct-Direct: 1` tells the shop we follow redirects that way.""" def __init__(self, masker, bearer=None, timeout=None, throttle=None): self.masker = masker self.bearer = bearer self.timeout = timeout self.throttle = throttle # shared 429 gate for requests to CryptoStruct (1.5) self.opener = urllib.request.build_opener() self.opener.addheaders = [] def request(self, method, url, headers=None, auth=True): """`auth=False` for a storage URL out of a member list: no Bearer (storage answers 400 to a second credential) and no opt-in header — those belong to the shop only.""" if auth and self.throttle is not None: self.throttle.wait() req = urllib.request.Request(url, method=method) req.add_header("User-Agent", USER_AGENT) req.add_header("Accept", "*/*") if auth: req.add_header(DIRECT_HEADER, "1") if self.bearer: req.add_unredirected_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + self.bearer) for k, v in (headers or {}).items(): req.add_header(k, v) timeout = self.timeout if self.timeout is not None else HTTP_TIMEOUT_S try: raw = self.opener.open(req, timeout=timeout) return HttpResponse(raw.status, raw.headers, raw, url) except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: return HttpResponse(e.code, e.headers, e, url) except (urllib.error.URLError, socket.timeout, http.client.HTTPException, ConnectionError, OSError) as e: raise TransientError(self.masker.mask("%s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, e))) except ValueError as e: raise UsageError(self.masker.mask("bad URL: %s" % e)) # ───────────────────────────── Manifest ───────────────────────────── class Manifest: def __init__(self, data, source): if not isinstance(data, dict): raise UsageError("manifest is not a JSON object") if data.get("schema") != SCHEMA_ID: raise UsageError("unsupported manifest schema %r (expected %s)" % (data.get("schema"), SCHEMA_ID)) self.data = data self.source = source self.scope = data.get("scope") or "order" self.site = data.get("site") self.orders = [o for o in (data.get("orders") or []) if isinstance(o, dict)] self.items = [i for i in (data.get("items") or []) if isinstance(i, dict)] self.bundles = [b for b in (data.get("bundles") or []) if isinstance(b, dict)] self.totals = data.get("totals") if isinstance(data.get("totals"), dict) else {} self.contract = data.get("contract") if isinstance(data.get("contract"), dict) else {} self.truncated = bool(data.get("truncated")) self.new_only = bool(data.get("new_only")) # new_only manifests leave downloaded-before items out and only count them here self.omitted = data.get("omitted_downloaded") if isinstance(data.get("omitted_downloaded"), dict) else {} # Large orders: one page of the order (follow page["next"]) / account manifests list them by reference self.page = data.get("page") if isinstance(data.get("page"), dict) else None self.large_orders = [o for o in (data.get("large_orders") or []) if isinstance(o, dict) and o.get("manifest_url")] @property def paged(self): return self.page is not None or bool(self.large_orders) # -- discovery ------------------------------------------------------- def all_urls(self): for it in self.items: for k in ("url", "status_url", "restore_url"): if it.get(k): yield it[k] fm = it.get("formats") if isinstance(fm, dict): for v in fm.values(): if v: yield v for b in self.bundles: for d in b.get("days") or []: for k in ("zip_url", "status_url", "restore_url", "manifest_url", "tar_url"): if isinstance(d, dict) and d.get(k): yield d[k] for c in b.get("range_chunks") or []: for k in ("url", "status_url", "restore_url", "manifest_url"): if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get(k): yield c[k] def secrets(self): seen = set() for u in self.all_urls(): for v in query_values(u, "t"): if v and v not in seen: seen.add(v) return sorted(seen) def absolutize(self, base): """Make relative URLs absolute against the manifest's site (or --base).""" root = self.site or base def fix(u): if u and not looks_like_url(u): return urllib.parse.urljoin(root.rstrip("/") + "/", u.lstrip("/")) return u for it in self.items: for k in ("url", "status_url", "restore_url"): if it.get(k): it[k] = fix(it[k]) fm = it.get("formats") if isinstance(fm, dict): for tok in list(fm.keys()): fm[tok] = fix(fm[tok]) for b in self.bundles: for d in b.get("days") or []: for k in ("zip_url", "status_url", "restore_url", "manifest_url", "tar_url"): if d.get(k): d[k] = fix(d[k]) for c in b.get("range_chunks") or []: for k in ("url", "status_url", "restore_url", "manifest_url"): if c.get(k): c[k] = fix(c[k]) def with_token(self, token): """Attach `t=` to every URL that lacks one (local manifest + --token).""" if not token: return def fix(u): return add_query(u, t=token) if (u and not query_values(u, "t")) else u for it in self.items: for k in ("url", "status_url", "restore_url"): if it.get(k): it[k] = fix(it[k]) fm = it.get("formats") if isinstance(fm, dict): for tok in list(fm.keys()): fm[tok] = fix(fm[tok]) for b in self.bundles: for d in b.get("days") or []: for k in ("zip_url", "status_url", "restore_url", "manifest_url", "tar_url"): if d.get(k): d[k] = fix(d[k]) for c in b.get("range_chunks") or []: for k in ("url", "status_url", "restore_url", "manifest_url"): if c.get(k): c[k] = fix(c[k]) # -- filters --------------------------------------------------------- def apply_filters(self, only=None, date_from=None, date_to=None): """In-place restriction to --only / --from / --to. A range chunk is kept only when it lies fully inside the window; the days of a partially covered chunk are fetched as per-day zips instead (never more than asked).""" def in_window(d): if not d or not DATE_RE.match(str(d)): return True dd = _dt.date.fromisoformat(str(d)) if date_from and dd date_to: return False return True if only == "bundles": self.items = [] if only == "tick": self.bundles = [] if date_from or date_to: self.items = [it for it in self.items if in_window(it.get("date"))] kept = [] for b in self.bundles: days = [d for d in (b.get("days") or []) if isinstance(d, dict) and in_window(d.get("date"))] chunks = [] for c in b.get("range_chunks") or []: if not isinstance(c, dict): continue if in_window(c.get("from")) and in_window(c.get("to")): chunks.append(c) b = dict(b) b["days"] = days b["range_chunks"] = chunks if days or chunks: kept.append(b) self.bundles = kept # -- loading --------------------------------------------------------- @staticmethod def load_file(path): try: data = read_json_file(path) except OSError as e: raise UsageError("cannot read manifest file %s: %s" % (path, e)) except ValueError as e: raise UsageError("manifest file %s is not valid JSON: %s" % (path, e)) return Manifest(data, path) @staticmethod def fetch(http, url, clock, log, masker): """One manifest request; transient trouble is retried with backoff.""" tries = 0 throttled_s = 0.0 while True: try: resp = http.request("GET", url) except TransientError as e: tries += 1 if tries >= MAX_TRANSIENT_TRIES: raise ManifestUnreachable("manifest unreachable after %d tries: %s" % (tries, e)) delay = backoff_seconds(tries) log.warn("manifest request failed (%s) — retrying in %s" % (e, human_duration(delay))) clock.sleep(delay) continue try: s = resp.status if s == 200: try: data = json.loads(resp.text()) except ValueError: raise ManifestUnreachable("manifest response is not JSON") return Manifest(data, masker.mask(url)) if s == 410: raise ExpiredLink(expired_hint(resp, None)) if s == 404: raise UsageError("manifest not found (404) — check the order id and the token/key") if s in (401, 403): raise UsageError("not allowed to read this manifest (HTTP %d) — check the token/key" % s) if s == 429: # Slow down (1.5): one shared pause, not one of the 8 transient tries. wait = resp.retry_after() if wait is None: wait = backoff_seconds(min(MAX_TRANSIENT_TRIES, 1 + int(throttled_s // BACKOFF_CAP_S))) wait = min(MAX_POLL_S, max(MIN_POLL_S, float(wait))) if throttled_s + wait > THROTTLE_MAX_PER_ITEM_S: raise ManifestUnreachable("manifest: the server kept asking to slow down for %s" % human_duration(throttled_s)) throttled_s += wait log.warn("manifest: HTTP 429 — the server asks to slow down, retrying in %s" % human_duration(wait)) if http.throttle is not None: http.throttle.close(wait) else: clock.sleep(wait) continue if s == 503: tries += 1 if tries >= MAX_TRANSIENT_TRIES: raise ManifestUnreachable("manifest unavailable (HTTP %d) after %d tries" % (s, tries)) wait = resp.retry_after() if wait is None: wait = backoff_seconds(tries) log.warn("manifest: HTTP %d — retrying in %s" % (s, human_duration(wait))) clock.sleep(wait) continue if s >= 500: tries += 1 if tries >= MAX_TRANSIENT_TRIES: raise ManifestUnreachable("manifest unavailable (HTTP %d) after %d tries" % (s, tries)) delay = backoff_seconds(tries) log.warn("manifest: HTTP %d — retrying in %s" % (s, human_duration(delay))) clock.sleep(delay) continue raise UsageError("unexpected HTTP %d while fetching the manifest" % s) finally: resp.close() def expired_hint(resp, contract): """Build the 410 message: 'this download link has expired — open or sign in'.""" hint = None try: err = resp.error_obj() if resp is not None else {} except Exception: err = {} top = {} try: j = resp.json() if resp is not None else None top = j if isinstance(j, dict) else {} except Exception: top = {} for src in (err, top): for k in ("claim_url", "hint", "claim"): v = src.get(k) if isinstance(src, dict) else None if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip(): hint = v.strip() break if hint: break if hint is None and isinstance(contract, dict): v = contract.get("expired") if isinstance(v, str) and looks_like_url(v.strip()): hint = v.strip() if hint and looks_like_url(hint): # never print a token: the claim link carries the guest token the caller already has hint = strip_query(hint, "t") if hint is None: hint = "the order link from your confirmation e-mail" return "this download link has expired — open %s or sign in" % hint def strip_query(url, name): parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url) q = [(k, v) for k, v in urllib.parse.parse_qsl(parts.query, keep_blank_values=True) if k != name] return urllib.parse.urlunsplit((parts.scheme, parts.netloc, parts.path, urllib.parse.urlencode(q), parts.fragment)) # ───────────────────────────── Ledger ───────────────────────────── class Ledger: """ /.cryptostruct-dl/ledger.json — every completed download, keyed by item.""" def __init__(self, out_dir, log): self.out_dir = out_dir self.dir = os.path.join(out_dir, LEDGER_DIR) self.path = "downloaded-before" t.downloaded_at = latest t.note = "every day of this chunk was downloaded before" return t.plan = "new" def _head_length(self, url): if not url: return None try: resp = self.http.request("HEAD", url) except TransientError: return None try: if resp.status == 410: raise ExpiredLink(expired_hint(resp, None)) if resp.status in (200, 206): return resp.content_length() return None finally: resp.close() # ───────────────────────────── Poller ───────────────────────────── class WaitBudget: """--max-wait-min, charged per item for every pending/cold/busy wait.""" def __init__(self, max_s): self.max_s = max_s self.used = 0.0 def charge(self, seconds, what): if self.used + seconds > self.max_s: raise ItemPending("still %s after waiting %s (limit %s) — re-run later to pick it up" % ( what, human_duration(self.used), human_duration(self.max_s))) self.used += seconds class AttemptState: def __init__(self, max_wait_s): self.tries = 0 # transient tries (network / 5xx) self.budget = WaitBudget(max_wait_s) self.throttled_s = 0.0 # 429 waits on this item — never charged to the budget (1.5) self.throttle_tries = 0 self.resumed_from = None self.started = time.monotonic() self.restore_fired = False # Range chunks (1.4): the day the transfer waits on and its best pending count. # Progress is measured in waited (budget) seconds, never wall time. self.stuck_key = None self.stuck_best = None self.stuck_since = 0.0 self.stuck_off = False # a split was not possible — wait as before class Session: """Everything the workers share.""" def __init__(self, opts, http, log, masker, ledger, sidecar, verify, out_dir, contract): self.opts = opts self.http = http self.log = log self.masker = masker self.ledger = ledger self.sidecar = sidecar self.verify = verify self.out_dir = out_dir self.contract = contract or {} self.stop = threading.Event() self.clock = Clock(self.stop) self.fatal = None self.restored = set() self._restored_lock = threading.Lock() self.results = [] self._results_lock = threading.Lock() self.total_new = 0 def check_stop(self): if self.stop.is_set(): raise Interrupted() def set_fatal(self, exc): if self.fatal is None: self.fatal = exc self.stop.set() def record(self, task, status, message=None, size=None, sha256=None, seconds=None, resumed_from=None, path=None): entry = { "key": task.key, "kind": task.kind, "order_id": task.order_id, "date": task.date, "filename": task.filename, "path": path if path is not None else task.rel_path, "status": status, "bytes": size, "sha256": sha256, "seconds": round(seconds, 1) if seconds is not None else None, "resumed_from": resumed_from, "message": self.masker.mask(message) if message else None, } with self._results_lock: self.results.append(entry) return entry def restore_cap(self): return getattr(self.opts, "restore_max", None) def restore_once(self, key): with self._restored_lock: if key in self.restored: return False cap = self.restore_cap() if cap is not None and len(self.restored) >= cap: return False self.restored.add(key) return True def restore_cap_reached(self, key): with self._restored_lock: cap = self.restore_cap() return cap is not None and key not in self.restored and len(self.restored) >= cap class Poller: """Waiting primitives shared by the file, zip and range flows.""" def __init__(self, session): self.s = session self.log = session.log self.http = session.http self.clock = session.clock self.opts = session.opts def tag(self, task): return "[%d/%d] %s" % (task.index, max(1, self.s.total_new), task.label()) def wait(self, task, st, seconds, why): if seconds is None: seconds = DEFAULT_RETRY_AFTER_S seconds = min(MAX_POLL_S, max(MIN_POLL_S, float(seconds))) st.budget.charge(seconds, why) self.log.progress("%s … %s — waiting %s" % (self.tag(task), why, human_duration(seconds))) self.clock.sleep(seconds) def transient(self, task, st, msg): st.tries += 1 if st.tries > MAX_TRANSIENT_TRIES: raise ItemFailed("gave up after %d tries: %s" % (MAX_TRANSIENT_TRIES, msg)) delay = backoff_seconds(st.tries) self.log.progress("%s … %s — retry %d/%d in %s" % (self.tag(task), msg, st.tries, MAX_TRANSIENT_TRIES, human_duration(delay))) self.clock.sleep(delay) def eta_text(self, obj): eta = obj.get("eta_seconds") if isinstance(obj, dict) else None try: if eta is not None and float(eta) > 0: return ", eta ~%s" % human_duration(float(eta)) except (TypeError, ValueError): pass return "" def pending(self, task, st, resp, restore_url, what="pending"): """A 202 answer: wait (or go cold on reason=archived).""" obj = resp.json() obj = obj if isinstance(obj, dict) else {} reason = obj.get("reason") or obj.get("state") or what if reason == "archived": self.cold(task, st, obj, restore_url, resp.retry_after()) return wait = resp.retry_after() if wait is None: wait = DEFAULT_RETRY_AFTER_S self.wait(task, st, wait, "%s (%s%s)" % (what, reason, self.eta_text(obj))) def busy(self, task, st, resp, label=None): """429: the server asks to slow down — pause every worker (throttled()); never charged to the per-item wait budget. 503: honour Retry-After within the budget; without one it is a transient error.""" wait = resp.retry_after() code = None try: code = resp.error_code() except Exception: code = None why = label or ("HTTP %d%s" % (resp.status, (" " + str(code)) if code else "")) if resp.status == 429: if wait is None: wait = backoff_seconds(max(1, st.throttle_tries + 1)) self.throttled(task, st, wait, why) return if wait is None: self.transient(task, st, why) return self.wait(task, st, wait, why) def throttled(self, task, st, seconds, why): """A 429: close the shared gate for Retry-After and let the caller ask again (its next request waits at the gate). --max-wait-min / --page-wait-min are for files that are not ready — a refused request says nothing about the file, so it never spends that budget. Only a file refused for THROTTLE_MAX_PER_ITEM_S in total is given up on (throttled).""" seconds = min(MAX_POLL_S, max(MIN_POLL_S, float(seconds))) st.throttle_tries += 1 gate = self.http.throttle # Close the gate first: even the 429 that makes this file give up tells the others to wait. if gate is not None and gate.close(seconds): self.log.progress("%s … server asks to slow down (%s) — all downloads pause %s" % ( self.tag(task), why, human_duration(seconds))) if st.throttled_s + seconds > THROTTLE_MAX_PER_ITEM_S: raise ItemThrottled("the server kept asking to slow down for %s — re-run later" % human_duration(st.throttled_s)) st.throttled_s += seconds if gate is None: self.clock.sleep(seconds) def cold(self, task, st, obj, restore_url, retry_after=None): """Cold storage: without --restore the item counts as cold; with it, restore once and wait.""" obj = obj if isinstance(obj, dict) else {} if not self.opts.restore: raise ItemCold("in cold storage — re-run with --restore (a restore takes up to ~12 h)") if not st.restore_fired: st.restore_fired = True if restore_url and self.s.restore_once(task.key): eta = self.fire_restore(task, st, restore_url) self.log.progress("%s … restore requested%s" % (self.tag(task), eta)) elif not restore_url: raise ItemFailed("in cold storage and the manifest has no restore link") elif self.s.restore_cap_reached(task.key): raise ItemCold("in cold storage — this run already requested %d restores (--restore-max); re-run later to request more" % self.s.restore_cap()) wait = retry_after if wait is None: wait = DEFAULT_RETRY_AFTER_S self.wait(task, st, wait, "restoring%s" % self.eta_text(obj)) def fire_restore(self, task, st, restore_url): while True: self.s.check_stop() try: resp = self.http.request("GET", restore_url) except TransientError as e: self.transient(task, st, "restore request failed: %s" % e) continue try: s = resp.status if 200 = 500: self.transient(task, st, "restore request: HTTP %d" % s) continue raise ItemFailed("restore request answered HTTP %d" % s) finally: resp.close() def get_json(self, task, st, url): """GET a JSON (or NDJSON) endpoint; waits/retries transient trouble; returns (status, text, resp-ish).""" while True: self.s.check_stop() try: resp = self.http.request("GET", url) except TransientError as e: self.transient(task, st, str(e)) continue try: s = resp.status text = resp.text() if s == 410: raise ExpiredLink(expired_hint(resp, self.s.contract)) if s in (429, 503): self.busy(task, st, resp) continue if s >= 500: self.transient(task, st, "HTTP %d" % s) continue return s, text, resp finally: resp.close() # ───────────────────────────── Bundles ───────────────────────────── def split_chunk(chunk, suggested_to, bundle_code): """Two chunk dicts: [from, suggested_to] and [suggested_to + 1, to].""" frm = str(chunk.get("from")) to = str(chunk.get("to")) cut = str(suggested_to or "") if not (DATE_RE.match(cut) and frm 0 def manifest_text_for(listing, entries): """The day's MANIFEST.txt — the server's text (byte-identical to the zip's) or, failing that, size\tname lines.""" txt = listing.get("manifest_txt") if isinstance(listing, dict) else None if isinstance(txt, str) and txt.strip(): return txt if txt.endswith("\n") else txt + "\n" return "".join("%d\t%s\n" % (int(e.get("size") or 0), e["name"]) for e in entries) def extract_archive(archive_path, dest_root, date_hint, log): """Extract a bundle zip/tar into / / . Never trusts member paths.""" count = 0 if archive_path.lower().endswith(".zip"): with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as zf: for info in zf.infolist(): if info.is_dir(): continue name = safe_component(os.path.basename(info.filename)) if name == "_": continue date = date_from_member_name(info.filename, date_hint) or "undated" dest_dir = os.path.join(dest_root, safe_component(date)) os.makedirs(dest_dir, exist_ok=True) dest = os.path.join(dest_dir, name) with zf.open(info) as src, open(dest + ".tmp", "wb") as dst: shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst, CHUNK_SIZE) os.replace(dest + ".tmp", dest) count += 1 else: with tarfile.open(archive_path, "r:*") as tf: for member in tf: if not member.isfile(): continue name = safe_component(os.path.basename(member.name)) if name == "_": continue date = date_from_member_name(member.name, date_hint) or "undated" dest_dir = os.path.join(dest_root, safe_component(date)) os.makedirs(dest_dir, exist_ok=True) dest = os.path.join(dest_dir, name) src = tf.extractfile(member) if src is None: continue with src, open(dest + ".tmp", "wb") as dst: shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst, CHUNK_SIZE) os.replace(dest + ".tmp", dest) count += 1 return count def dir_bytes(path): total = 0 try: for name in os.listdir(path): p = os.path.join(path, name) if os.path.isfile(p): total += os.path.getsize(p) except OSError: pass return total def salvage_range_part(part_path, dest_root, dates=None): """Unpack every COMPLETE day of a partial range tar into / / (the direct / --extract layout). A range tar holds RANGE_MANIFEST.txt, then per day /MANIFEST.txt followed by the day's member files. Days are staged in /.salvage- / and moved into place only when their MANIFEST.txt lists nothing but files that came out whole — the day cut off by the end of the partial file (and anything after it) is dropped. Returns the dates moved into place.""" wanted = set(dates) if dates else None staged = {} try: with tarfile.open(part_path, "r:") as tf: for member in tf: if not member.isfile(): continue pieces = member.name.split("/") if len(pieces) != 2 or not DATE_RE.match(pieces[0]): continue # RANGE_MANIFEST.txt date, name = pieces[0], safe_component(pieces[1]) if name == "_" or (wanted is not None and date not in wanted): continue stage = staged.get(date) if stage is None: stage = os.path.join(dest_root, SALVAGE_DIR_PREFIX + date) shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True) os.makedirs(stage) staged[date] = stage src = tf.extractfile(member) if src is None: continue dest = os.path.join(stage, name) with src, open(dest + ".tmp", "wb") as dst: shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst, CHUNK_SIZE) if os.path.getsize(dest + ".tmp") != member.size: break os.replace(dest + ".tmp", dest) except (tarfile.TarError, EOFError, OSError): pass # the end of the partial archive moved = [] for date, stage in sorted(staged.items()): final = os.path.join(dest_root, safe_component(date)) if day_dir_complete(stage) and not day_dir_complete(final): shutil.rmtree(final, ignore_errors=True) os.replace(stage, final) moved.append(date) else: shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True) return moved # ───────────────────────────── Downloader ───────────────────────────── class StreamResult: def __init__(self, size, sha256, digest, server_filename, etag): self.size = size self.sha256 = sha256 self.digest = digest self.server_filename = server_filename self.etag = etag class UrlListRefresher: """A day's member URLs expire (storage TTL, 1 h). When a member meets 401/403 the first worker fetches ONE fresh list from the shop and every other worker reuses it until it is half-way to expiry itself. Thread-safe; the server logs the handout once per list, so lists stay rare.""" def __init__(self, downloader, task, url, listing): self.d = downloader self.task = task self.url = url self.lock = threading.Lock() self.fetched_at = time.monotonic() self.urls = self._index(listing) self.ttl = self._ttl(listing) @staticmethod def _index(listing): return dict((e.get("name"), e.get("url")) for e in (listing.get("entries") or []) if isinstance(e, dict)) @staticmethod def _ttl(listing): try: return max(60.0, float(listing.get("expires_in") or 3600)) except (TypeError, ValueError): return 3600.0 def url_for(self, name): with self.lock: if time.monotonic() - self.fetched_at > self.ttl * 0.5: st = AttemptState(self.d.opts.max_wait_s) listing = self.d._fetch_url_list(self.task, st, self.url) if listing is None: return None self.urls = self._index(listing) self.ttl = self._ttl(listing) self.fetched_at = time.monotonic() self.d.log.progress("%s … storage URLs expired — fetched a fresh list" % self.d.poll.tag(self.task)) return self.urls.get(name) class Downloader: """Runs the plan: files in parallel, bundle days ≤ 2 at a time (zip, or member files straight from storage with DIRECT_PARALLEL in flight), range chunks one at a time per order.""" def __init__(self, session, plan): self.s = session self.plan = plan self.log = session.log self.http = session.http self.clock = session.clock self.opts = session.opts self.poll = Poller(session) self.zip_pool = None # Day tasks a split range hands to the zip pool (1.4); run() waits for them too, # so the range worker can move on to the next chunk at once. self._spawned = {} self._spawn_lock = threading.Lock() session.total_new = len(plan.new_tasks) # -- orchestration ---------------------------------------------------- def run(self): opts = self.opts file_pool = concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, int(opts.parallel)), thread_name_prefix="file") zip_pool = concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=ZIP_PARALLEL, thread_name_prefix="zip") self.zip_pool = zip_pool range_pools = {} futures = {} for task in self.plan.new_tasks: if task.kind in ("tick", "minute_csv", "format"): fut = file_pool.submit(self._guard, self._run_file, task) elif task.kind == "bundle_day": fut = zip_pool.submit(self._guard, self._run_day, task) elif task.kind == "range": pool = range_pools.get(task.order_id) if pool is None: pool = concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1, thread_name_prefix="range") range_pools[task.order_id] = pool fut = pool.submit(self._guard, self._run_range, task) else: continue futures[fut] = task interrupted = False pending = set(futures) try: while True: pending |= self._take_spawned(futures) if not pending: break _done, pending = concurrent.futures.wait(pending, timeout=0.25) if self.s.fatal is not None: break except KeyboardInterrupt: interrupted = True self.s.stop.set() self.log.progress("interrupted — finishing the ledger; re-run the same command to resume") pools = [file_pool, zip_pool] + list(range_pools.values()) for p in pools: p.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True) self._take_spawned(futures) if interrupted or self.s.fatal is not None: self.s.stop.set() for fut, task in futures.items(): if fut.cancelled(): self.s.record(task, "interrupted" if interrupted else "aborted", "not started") remaining = [f for f in futures if not f.done()] if remaining: try: concurrent.futures.wait(remaining, timeout=SHUTDOWN_GRACE_S) except KeyboardInterrupt: pass return interrupted def _spawn(self, fn, task): """Run a derived task on the zip pool without waiting for it (run() collects it).""" try: fut = self.zip_pool.submit(self._guard, fn, task) except RuntimeError: # pool already shut down (Ctrl-C / fatal error) self.s.record(task, "interrupted" if self.s.fatal is None else "aborted", "not started") return with self._spawn_lock: self._spawned[fut] = task def _take_spawned(self, futures): with self._spawn_lock: fresh = dict(self._spawned) self._spawned.clear() futures.update(fresh) return set(fresh) def _guard(self, fn, *args): task = args[0] try: fn(*args) except ItemFailed as e: self.s.record(task, "failed", str(e)) self.log.progress("%s … failed: %s" % (self.poll.tag(task), e)) except ItemCold as e: self.s.record(task, "cold", str(e)) self.log.progress("%s … cold: %s" % (self.poll.tag(task), e)) except ItemPending as e: self.s.record(task, "pending", str(e)) self.log.progress("%s … left pending: %s" % (self.poll.tag(task), e)) except ItemThrottled as e: self.s.record(task, "throttled", str(e)) self.log.progress("%s … throttled: %s" % (self.poll.tag(task), e)) except Interrupted: self.s.record(task, "interrupted" if self.s.fatal is None else "aborted", "stopped before completion") except ExpiredLink as e: self.s.record(task, "aborted", str(e)) self.s.set_fatal(e) except UsageError as e: self.s.record(task, "failed", str(e)) except TransientError as e: self.s.record(task, "failed", str(e)) except Exception as e: # never let one item kill the run self.s.record(task, "failed", "internal error: %s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, e)) self.log.warn("%s: internal error: %s: %s" % (task.label(), type(e).__name__, e)) # -- single files (tick / minute_csv / derived formats) ---------------- def _run_file(self, task): item = task.ref if task.kind == "format": url = (item.get("formats") or {}).get(task.fmt) if not url: raise ItemFailed("manifest lists no %s link for this file" % task.fmt) st = AttemptState(self.opts.max_wait_s) if not self._format_probe(task, st, url): self.s.record(task, "empty", "no rows for %s — nothing to download" % task.fmt) self.log.progress("%s … empty (no %s rows) — skipped" % (self.poll.tag(task), task.fmt)) return restore_url = item.get("restore_url") else: url = item.get("url") if not url: raise ItemFailed("manifest item has no url") restore_url = item.get("restore_url") final = task.abs_path part = final + PART_SUFFIX for attempt in (1, 2): st = AttemptState(self.opts.max_wait_s) res = self._download_resumable(task, st, url, part, mode="file", restore_url=restore_url) try: self._finalize(task, st, part, res) return except VerifyError as e: remove_quiet(part) remove_quiet(meta_path_for(part)) if attempt == 1: self.log.progress("%s … verification failed (%s) — downloading once more" % (self.poll.tag(task), e)) continue raise ItemFailed("verification failed: %s (file discarded)" % e) def _format_probe(self, task, st, url): """Poll `url&probe=1` until ready (True) or empty (False); failed/unavailable raise.""" probe_url = add_query(url, probe="1") while True: s, text, resp = self.poll.get_json(task, st, probe_url) try: obj = json.loads(text) if text else {} except ValueError: obj = {} obj = obj if isinstance(obj, dict) else {} if s in (200, 202): state = obj.get("state") or ("pending" if s == 202 else "ready") if state == "ready": return True if state == "empty": return False if state in ("failed", "unavailable", "error"): raise ItemFailed("%s export %s%s" % (task.fmt, state, (": " + str(obj.get("reason"))) if obj.get("reason") else "")) wait = resp.retry_after() self.poll.wait(task, st, wait if wait is not None else DEFAULT_RETRY_AFTER_S, "preparing %s (%s%s)" % (task.fmt, obj.get("reason") or state, self.poll.eta_text(obj))) continue if s == 409: self.poll.cold(task, st, obj, task.ref.get("restore_url"), resp.retry_after()) continue if s in (401, 403, 404): raise ItemFailed("HTTP %d on the %s export" % (s, task.fmt)) raise ItemFailed("unexpected HTTP %d on the %s probe" % (s, task.fmt)) # -- resumable stream (files, formats, range chunks, day tars) -------- def _download_resumable(self, task, st, url, part, mode, restore_url=None): """Loop until `part` holds the complete body. mode: file | range | daytar.""" is_range = mode == "range" while True: self.s.check_stop() resume_from = os.path.getsize(part) if os.path.exists(part) else 0 meta = read_part_meta(part) if resume_from > 0 else {} headers = {} if resume_from > 0: headers["Range"] = "bytes=%d-" % resume_from etag = meta.get("etag") if etag and not str(etag).startswith("W/"): headers["If-Range"] = str(etag) try: resp = self.http.request("GET", url, headers) except TransientError as e: self.poll.transient(task, st, str(e)) continue try: s = resp.status if s in (200, 206): res = self._pump(task, st, resp, part, resume_from, meta) if res is not None: return res continue if s == 416: res = self._handle_416(task, st, resp, part, resume_from, meta) if res is not None: return res continue if s == 202: self.poll.pending(task, st, resp, restore_url) continue if s in (429, 503): if is_range and s == 503 and resp.error_code() == "WARMING": body = resp.json() if isinstance(resp.json(), dict) else {} date = body.get("date") pend = body.get("pending") self._stuck_check(st, "day:%s" % date, as_int(pend) if pend is not None else None, date) self.poll.busy(task, st, resp) continue if s == 410: raise ExpiredLink(expired_hint(resp, self.s.contract)) if s == 409: code = resp.error_code() if code == "SIZE_DRIFT": raise ItemFailed("the server reports a size drift for this range — contact support") self.poll.cold(task, st, resp.error_obj(), restore_url, resp.retry_after()) continue if s == 413: if is_range: err = resp.error_obj() raise SplitChunk(err.get("suggested_to")) raise ItemFailed("HTTP 413 — too large for this route") if s == 404 and is_range: raise RangeNotFound() if s in (401, 403, 404): raise ItemFailed("HTTP %d" % s) if s >= 500: self.poll.transient(task, st, "HTTP %d" % s) continue raise ItemFailed("unexpected HTTP %d" % s) finally: resp.close() def _handle_416(self, task, st, resp, part, resume_from, meta): if resume_from MAX_TRANSIENT_TRIES: raise ItemFailed("could not resume after %d tries" % MAX_TRANSIENT_TRIES) return None def _pump(self, task, st, resp, part, resume_from, meta): """Write a 200/206 body to `part`. Returns a StreamResult, or None to retry (part kept for resume).""" status = resp.status total = None if status == 206: cr = parse_content_range(resp.header("Content-Range")) if cr is None or cr[0] != resume_from: self.log.progress("%s … server resumed at the wrong offset — starting over" % self.poll.tag(task)) remove_quiet(part) remove_quiet(meta_path_for(part)) st.tries += 1 if st.tries > MAX_TRANSIENT_TRIES: raise ItemFailed("could not resume after %d tries" % MAX_TRANSIENT_TRIES) return None total = cr[2] file_mode = "ab" st.resumed_from = resume_from else: if resume_from > 0: self.log.progress("%s … server restarted the transfer from zero (no resume)" % self.poll.tag(task)) resume_from = 0 file_mode = "wb" total = resp.content_length() etag = resp.header("ETag") or meta.get("etag") digest = parse_repr_digest(resp.header("Repr-Digest")) or meta.get("digest") server_filename = parse_content_disposition_filename(resp.header("Content-Disposition")) or meta.get("server_filename") os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(part), exist_ok=True) write_part_meta(part, {"etag": etag, "digest": digest, "server_filename": server_filename, "total": t
